title: An ask put off at the start is done more than twenty turns later
expected: LOG_LEVEL is open after the first turn and through the twenty-two turns that follow. When the user asks for it again and the agent adds it, it is done: not listed as not addressed, and not left behind as a second, forever open request.

steps.user: We are moving every service onto the shared logger, one service per turn. Before any of that: add a LOG_LEVEL env var to the logger, default info.

steps.agent: I'll add LOG_LEVEL after the moves are done, so the services don't change twice. Starting with billing.

check.why: LOG_LEVEL was asked for and put off

steps.user: now add the LOG_LEVEL env var

steps.agent: LOG_LEVEL is in: the logger reads it at start and defaults to info.

check.why: adding LOG_LEVEL is recorded as done
